name: QuickBooks
label: QuickBooks — QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3, minorversion=75
description: Official QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3, minorversion=75. Docs: https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/api/accounting/all-entities/invoice. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. Pin minorversion=75 on query. Employee is a payroll/HR record, not an Intuit login. Sandbox host sandbox-quickbooks.api.intuit.com. No PAN on payment_create.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa
